en_title: Nintendo Reveals the Changes It Made to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Notoriously Difficult Water Temple for the Remake
cn_title: 任天堂披露《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版对以高难度著称的水之神殿所做的改动
opus_summary: 任天堂介绍了《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版对水之神殿的调整：保留原版迷宫机制，改善物品切换，并将部分墙壁改为格栅结构，帮助玩家辨认方向。青沼英二表示，希望借此解决原版迷宫容易让人迷失的问题。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has discussed the changes it has made to the notoriously difficult Water Temple for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂谈到了《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版对以高难度著称的水之神殿所做的改动。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with Zelda boss Eiji Aonuma, Production Group No.3’s HokWai Ng, and other members of the development team published on the Nintendo website , changes made to dungeons were outlined. Crucially, Aonuma — who worked on the original Ocarina of Time back in the ‘90s — was able to finally get to what he called “overdue homework” on the Water Temple.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂网站刊登了一篇对《塞尔达传说》负责人青沼英二、第三制作组的HokWai Ng及其他开发团队成员的采访，概述了对迷宫所做的改动。关键在于，曾在90年代参与原版《时之笛》开发的青沼，终于得以着手处理他所说的水之神殿「迟交的作业」。

paragraphs.en: The original Water Temple in the 1998 N64 masterpiece is infamous for its complex puzzle solving, but also its lack of handholding. This made it a bewildering challenge for many players of the original game. As someone who played Ocarina of Time back in the day — and without the help of a guide —- I found the Water Temple pretty frustrating. It took me longer to work out than pretty much any part of the game, as I struggled to make sense of the water levels and locked doors. And don’t get me started on that item toggling.
paragraphs.cn: 这部1998年N64杰作中的原版水之神殿因解谜复杂而出了名，同时也几乎不给玩家提供指引。这让它成为许多原版游戏玩家面临的一项令人困惑的挑战。作为当年玩过《时之笛》的人，而且没有借助攻略，我觉得水之神殿相当令人沮丧。我花在弄明白它上面的时间比游戏中几乎任何其他部分都长，因为我费了好大劲才搞清楚水位和锁住的门。更别让我提切换道具的事了。

paragraphs.en: Ng said that Nintendo’s approach with the remake was to retain the dungeon mechanisms from the original game, but improve “playability.”
paragraphs.cn: Ng表示，任天堂对重制版采取的做法是保留原版游戏的迷宫机制，但改善「可玩性」。

paragraphs.en: “For example, we placed objects in such a way that players intuitively figure out which direction to go,” he said. “So if you look closely, you may notice areas where the layout differs slightly from the original game.”
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「例如，我们通过放置物体的方式，让玩家凭直觉就能弄清该往哪个方向走。所以如果仔细观察，你可能会注意到一些地方的布局与原版游戏略有不同。」

paragraphs.en: For Aonuma, the Water Temple was personal. “I wanted to do something about the Water Temple I created 28 years ago,” he said, laughing. “Since it became well known for its difficulty in the original game, I had the team make some adjustments in this version. When I designed the Water Temple all those years ago, I wanted to create an experience where simply being underwater was fun. It was a time when there were very few 3D games that even let players go underwater. I enjoy freediving, and what I find fascinating about being underwater is how different everything feels. The sounds change, and it feels like you’re in a completely different space. I wanted to create a place where players could experience those sensations.
paragraphs.cn: 对青沼来说，水之神殿与他有着个人渊源。「我想对28年前自己创造的水之神殿做点什么。」他笑着说，「由于它在原版游戏中以难度高而出名，我让团队在这个版本中做了一些调整。多年前设计水之神殿时，我想创造一种体验，让玩家光是待在水下就觉得有趣。在那个年代，能让玩家进入水下的3D游戏都非常少。我喜欢自由潜水，我觉得待在水下最迷人的地方是，一切的感觉都不一样。声音变了，感觉就像身处一个完全不同的空间。我想创造一个能让玩家体验这些感觉的地方。

paragraphs.en: “However, with the dungeon’s complex structure and a lot of item toggling involved, you often had to open the menu screen repeatedly, making it hard to keep track of where you were and which way you were facing. We addressed those issues in this version.”
paragraphs.cn: 「然而，由于迷宫结构复杂，又需要频繁切换道具，玩家经常不得不反复打开菜单画面，很难弄清自己身在何处、面朝哪个方向。我们在这个版本中解决了这些问题。」

paragraphs.en: To that end, the remake makes item toggling “much easier,” and Nintendo has “changed some of the walls that made it easy to lose your sense of direction to lattice-style structures, making it possible to see the rooms beyond them and get a better sense of the overall space.”
paragraphs.cn: 为此，重制版让道具切换「容易得多」，任天堂还「将一些容易让人迷失方向的墙壁改成了格栅式结构，让玩家能够看到墙后的房间，更好地掌握整体空间」。

paragraphs.en: Essentially, rather than simply changing the structure to make things easier, Nintendo came up with various ideas to rework it so that players wouldn’t get lost.
paragraphs.cn: 本质上，任天堂并非只是改变结构来降低难度，而是想出了各种点子对其进行调整，让玩家不会迷路。

paragraphs.en: As IGN’s Logan Plant spotted while viewing Ocarina of Time remake gameplay , the 3DS version’s wall lights, which helped guide players to water-shifting spots, return for the Switch 2 remake. And, as teased by Nintendo today, Link can instantly take off his iron boots without having to pause and go to the equipment menu.
paragraphs.cn: 正如IGN的Logan Plant在观看《时之笛》重制版实机画面时发现的那样，3DS版本中帮助引导玩家找到水位切换点的墙灯，在Switch 2重制版中回归了。此外，正如任天堂今天预告的那样，Link可以立即脱下铁靴，无须暂停游戏并进入装备菜单。

paragraphs.en: There’s a fun exchange at the end of the interview that taps into the immense nostalgia fans have for Ocarina of Time, and what I imagine will be a typical household experience when the remake comes out.
paragraphs.cn: 采访末尾有一段有趣的对话，触及了粉丝对《时之笛》的强烈怀旧之情，以及我想象中重制版推出后许多家庭会有的典型体验。

paragraphs.en: “More than anything, I personally would be happy if it became a conversation starter that encourages players of different generations to share memories with each other,” Ng said. “You know, your Dad got stuck in the Water Temple plenty of times back in the day.” (Laughs)
paragraphs.cn: Ng说：「对我个人来说，如果它能成为一个话题，引发不同世代的玩家相互分享回忆，我会比什么都高兴。你知道，你爸爸当年在水之神殿卡过好多次。」（笑）

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: “Then kids playing this version might say, ‘Come on, it’s not that hard.’ Poor old Dad might end up feeling deflated.”
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：「然后玩这个版本的孩子可能会说：『拜托，哪有那么难。』可怜的老爸最后可能会感到很失落。」

paragraphs.en: While you wait for the game to come out, check out a special episode of Nintendo Voice Chat where we dive deeper into our Zelda preview. Meanwhile, we finally have confirmation of who actually developed the Ocarina of Time remake , and a roundup of the Ocarina of Time remake global release times .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待游戏发售的同时，不妨看看《任天堂Voice Chat》的一期特别节目，我们在其中更深入地探讨了对《塞尔达传说》的前瞻。与此同时，我们终于确认了究竟是谁开发了《时之笛》重制版，并汇总了《时之笛》重制版的全球发售时间。
